import{JSDOM}from'jsdom';const d=new JSDOM('<body><main></main>');for(const k of ['window','document','Node','Element','HTMLElement','HTMLInputElement','HTMLFormElement','Event','CustomEvent','MutationObserver','getComputedStyle'])globalThis[k]=d.window[k];
const {mount}=await import(process.argv[2]);let submitted=0,invalid=0;const a=mount({host:document.querySelector('main'),schema:{$formkit:'group',name:'g',children:[{if:'false',then:{$el:'section',children:[{$formkit:'text',name:'hiddenRequired',validation:'required'}]}}]},formProps:{actions:false},config:{delay:0},onSubmit:()=>submitted++,onSubmitInvalid:()=>invalid++});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,25));await a.submit();console.log(JSON.stringify({inputs:document.querySelectorAll('input').length,coreChildren:a.node.at('g').children.map(n=>n.name),submitted,invalid,valid:a.node.context.state.valid}));a.destroy();d.window.close();
argumentsNote: Read the runtime index URL from argv[2] when running this source via --eval, or argv[3] when using the recorded stdin command node --input-type=module - probe <URL>.
